name: us airman

events.event: Pentagon's inspector general released a report detailing damage to US bases and embassies across eight countries.
The report stated that the war resulted in strategic inventory shortfalls for munitions.
The report stated that the US war with Iran cost $33.4 billion between February 28 and June 30.
The report stated that $22.3 billion of the war's cost was spent on munitions.
U.S. Air Force officer shot down in Iran described the survival as a 'modern-day miracle'.
The report listed four F-15 fighter jets destroyed, one F-35 damaged, and seven KC-135 tankers damaged.
The F-15E fighter jet was shot down by an Iranian shoulder-fired missile on April 2.
Bravo sent a message to US forces saying 'God is good'.
Bravo climbed to a 7,000-foot ridgeline to evade Iranian forces.
The report estimated $184 million in damage to US diplomatic facilities in the Middle East.
More than 90 American service members were deployed in a rescue operation for Bravo.
The pilot 'Alpha' was rescued about six hours after the crash during a risky daytime operation.
The rescue helicopters came under fire during the extraction of Alpha.
US bombers and drones struck IRGC forces near Bravo's hiding place.
The rescue force arrived at dawn on Easter Sunday to extract Bravo.
The US military destroyed two rescue aircraft to prevent sensitive technology from falling into Iranian hands.
The war with Iran was launched more than six months ago and shows no signs of ending.
The United States fired off thousands of long-range, precision-guided missiles in the early days of the conflict.
The Pentagon ordered the defense industry onto a 'wartime footing' to replenish depleted stockpiles.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reportedly pressured two rescued airmen to appear on Bari Weiss's 60 Minutes.
A 70-year-old hiker was rescued on Saturday after a week-long search on Isle Royale.
A US Air Force officer identified as 'Dude 44 Bravo' revealed he survived for nearly 50 hours in Iran.
The report estimated $157 million in damage to US diplomatic facilities in Iraq.
The report stated that up to 3,500 diplomatic personnel were displaced from the region.
The report noted that Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE were placed under ordered departure.
The report stated that damage to the US Navy's hub in Bahrain created significant challenges for establishing naval bases.
The report stated that US military resupply cycles stretched to 14-18 days due to the shift to Diego Garcia.
The report stated that the US Embassy in Kuwait suspended operations after being struck by Iranian drones.
The report stated that the US Embassy in Kuwait resumed emergency operations in late June.
The report stated that more than 600 attacks against US facilities in Iraq were recorded.
